newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bull limit up in Bourse twist.
newsitem.headline: Bull limit up in Bourse twist.

text.p: Shares in computer maker Bull were suspended limit-up on Friday even though the share was down, due to a twist in the Paris bourse rules.
The share was suspended limit up at 49.35 francs, or down 1.2 percent, until 1100 GMT, a bourse official said, when its new upper limit will be 50.55 francs and the lower limit 48.15 francs.
Bull was requoted on Friday after a suspension which began on April 11 to allow the government to sell 17.1 million of its shares.
The share opened on Friday at 47.00 francs against an April 11 close of 49.95 francs, and went as low as 45.50 before rising again.

But the Bourse put its 5.0 percent movement limits around the Friday opening price -- instead of the more typical previous closing price -- and the share triggered a limit-up suspension during its rebound.
